notes: Background: Northbridge runs a large omnichannel support stack (Zendesk + internal order ops). Heavy seasonal spikes Nov-Dec (peak volume x6).
Primary ask: replace slow manual tagging + summarization pipeline. Need structured ticket summaries for agents and downstream analytics (fields: summary, root_cause, action_required, SLA_risk).
POC scope agreed: 10k tickets (historical) for model tuning + live 7-day sandbox for agents (Zendesk sandbox) — focus on email->ticket summarization and auto-tagging first.

Latency/throughput targets: agent-assist generation <500ms (prefer <300ms) for short summaries; background batch summarization allowed up to 2s. Peak concurrent requests estimated 1500 reqs/min during normal, 9000+ during peak windows.
Model prefs: open/quantized variants preferred; propose Redwood verified Llama-2/UL2 variants; fallback policy wanted (smaller model for low-priority tickets).
Routing/fallback: must support region routing (NA primary, EU for EU-resident tickets), and deterministic fallback to cheaper model when quota/burst used.
Security notes: strict PII controls. Must integrate with company KMS (AWS KMS) + SSO/SAML. Audit logs must surface per-request token usage and redaction metadata.
Integration requirements: Zendesk triggers/macros mapping, Freshdesk mapping for legacy team. Need webhook tool-calling to internal order-service (idempotent calls, retry logic).
Observability ask: cost-per-ticket breakouts, token-level latency histograms, and alerting on model quality regressions tied to golden prompt set.

Quotes from sponsor: "Need summaries that our agents trust immediately — one-line TL;DR + 3 bullets for action. If it slows agents down they won't adopt."
Technical risks called out by SE: prefix caching needed for threads where customers send multi-email chains; KV-cache and batching to reduce per-token cost but must keep per-agent latency SLOs.

Commercials: Northbridge expects tiered pricing — high-volume discount, and optional dedicated pool for peak season. CFO asked for 12-month ARR granularity in proposal (submitted: drive/Deals/Northbridge/Redwood_POC_Proposal_v1.pdf).
POC success criteria: 1) tag accuracy > 88% on top 10 tags, 2) agent-reported time-saved > 12%, 3) end-to-end median latency <400ms during non-peak, and 4) security sign-off complete.
